title: Urban Street Choreography (Crew Cam)
subtitle: 110 BPM · Underground Crew Studio · Hip-Hop Locking & Wave Routine
dancer_coaching_notes: Heavy 110 BPM street-dance pocket. Let your knees absorb the downbeat bounce while keeping upper-body pops and freezes razor-sharp on the snare.

sections.name: BOUNCE CYPHER
sections.summary: Heavy hip-hop groove with grounded footsteps and forearm locks.

sections.name: ISOLATION FLOW
sections.summary: Intricate arm waves and Brooklyn glides leading to the crew break.

sections.name: CREW ROUTINE DROP
sections.summary: Full-impact 808 bass drop with explosive jumps, counter-jabs, and spins.

sections.name: STREET FINALE
sections.summary: Slow-motion glides and double-arm waves riding out the beat.
